chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-ʿAlāʾ, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about urine that affects the body. He said: “Pour water over it twice.”

key_terms.الْبَوْلِ: urine, the najasah being discussed in the ruling
key_terms.الْجَسَدَ: the body, meaning the part of the body affected by impurity
key_terms.الْمَاءَ: water, the purifying substance used for cleansing
key_terms.صُبَّ: pour, the commanded method of applying water
key_terms.مَرَّتَيْنِ: twice, specifying the number of washings required

ai.seo_question: How should the body be purified if urine gets on it according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding purification when urine comes into contact with the body. Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام instructs that water should be poured over the affected area twice, indicating the method of removing this najasah.
